question: Where are all gods dissolved and worshipped?
premises: That is always worshipped in the middle.
Meru assembly and element-direction banner are named.
inference: The verse places all gods dissolved in a worshipped Meru assembly with directional banner.
plain_english: All gods are indeed dissolved there; that is always worshipped in the middle, in the Meru assembly, with element and lord-direction banner.
